description: This file implements the IAudioFlinger interface, including proxy class BpAudioFlinger and transaction handling for Android's media audio system. It defines methods for creating audio tracks, opening/closing audio inputs and outputs, setting volumes, querying effects, and managing hardware modules.

classes.name: BpAudioFlinger
classes.description: Proxy class for IAudioFlinger interface, providing client-side implementations of audio control methods.

methods.name: createTrack
methods.description: Creates an audio track with specified parameters and returns a binder interface to it.

methods.name: openRecord
methods.description: Opens an audio input stream for recording.

methods.name: sampleRate
methods.description: Retrieves the sample rate for a given output handle.

methods.name: channelCount

methods.name: format

methods.name: frameCount

methods.name: latency

methods.name: masterVolume
